method.method_draft: Use the local triangle around F. From the image, read that A,F,D are collinear and B,G,F,E are collinear, with G on AC, so triangle AFG has angle at A equal to the given ∠A = 20°. The text gives ∠AFG = ∠AGF, so triangle AFG is isosceles in angles and each of those two angles is (180°−20°)/2 = 80°. In the image, ∠AFG is an exterior angle of triangle BFD because FA is the extension of FD and FG lies on FB. Therefore by the exterior-angle theorem, ∠B + ∠D = ∠AFG = 80°.
